title: Order cancellation with fixed supplied tests
prompt: Implement durable single and batch order cancellation as specified in README.md. The complete regression and cancellation acceptance tests are already supplied. Modify only existing Python source files under orders/. Do not create, modify, or delete tests, test data, README.md, or other files. Do not write additional tests or alternative verification scripts. Use the available source-editing tools for source changes. Run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v after your final changes.
